steps.title: Parse bold and italic
steps.description: Create `parseBold` and `parseItalic` functions. Bold text uses `**text**` → `text`. Italic uses `*text*` → `text`. Chain them together in a `parseInline` function.
hints: Use .replace() with a regex to find **text** patterns
Parse bold first, then italic, to avoid conflicts
